parts.text: Add threaded comments to task cards, easy to skim on a phone and ready to pass to the implementer as-is.
Effort: about 2 weeks.
Surfaces touched: 3 packages.
New tables: 2.
Feature flag: task_comments_v1.
Ship in four slices, each independently reviewable and each behind the flag. Nothing is user-visible until slice 4.
Week 1, Mon-Tue: schema and API contract. New comments and comment_reads tables, migrations and the tRPC router stubs. No UI. The contract is reviewed before anything else lands.
Week 1, Wed-Fri: thread component and composer. A static CommentThread rendered from fixtures. Optimistic insert on submit, rollback on failure, one level of nesting only.
Week 2, Mon-Wed: realtime fan-out and unread state. Subscribe the open card to its comment channel. Track per-user read cursors so the sidebar shows an unread count without a second query.
Week 2, Thu-Fri: notifications, flag ramp, docs. Mention detection writes a notification row, with an email digest fallback. Ramp task_comments_v1 to internal, then 10% to 100% over three days.
Data flow: the optimistic write path runs client to persistence; realtime fan-out runs to other clients. The read cursor update is fire-and-forget, so the thread render never waits on it.
Mockups, not pixel-final: A is a thread inside an open task card; B is a sidebar unread digest. They settle nesting depth, composer placement and the digest look.
Key code: the migration (soft deletes, read cursors) and the optimistic mutation (temp-id reconciliation) are the two pieces most likely to be done wrong.
comments has a parent_id for one level of nesting, enforced in the API, and a deleted_at column for soft delete; comment_reads is keyed by task and user.
useAddComment inserts a temp row on mutate, swaps it for the real row on success so the realtime append does not duplicate it, and removes it on error.
Realtime duplicate: the socket append races with the HTTP response and the temp-id reconcile. Severity HIGH.
Mitigation: dedupe on the server-assigned id in the cache updater; the socket payload carries the real id and temp rows are filtered on reconcile.
Unread counts go stale when a user reads the thread on another device. Severity MED.
Mitigation: broadcast comment_reads upserts on the same channel; the client treats its own cursor as max(local, remote).
Mention detection false-positives on pasted markdown such as @media and @2x. Severity LOW.
Mitigation: resolve mentions against workspace members only, at write time, and store the resolved user ids; never re-parse on read.
Do we allow editing, or only delete-and-repost?
Simpler, but loses the reply anchor.
Leaning toward delete-only for v1.
Needs an edited_at column and an edited affordance.
Email digest cadence when a user has the app closed
